items.markdown:
Omega Services[Omega Services](https://omegatechserv.com/about-us/about-omega/) maintains an active operational presence directly in Norwest , having listed a regional business address at Suite 6964, 26 Brookhollow Avenue, Norwest NSW 2153, alongside its broader Sydney-wide service network.[[1]](https://omegaservices.com.au/)

#### Presence & Operations in Norwest

- **Local Footprint** : They service the Hills District and Norwest business/residential precinct for plumbing, electrical, hot water, and drain solutions.[[1]](https://omegaservices.com.au/)
- **General Popularity** : Across Greater Sydney, Omega Services is a well-established mid-to-large trade provider (operating since 2004 with a high volume of verified customer reviews averaging around 4.5/5 stars).[[1]](https://omegaservices.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CCYSDyoNCgsvZy8xdGRfNWI1MhgK)
- **Core Offerings** : Frequently utilized in commercial and residential settings for upfront per-job pricing, emergency electrical/plumbing calls, and switchboard or pipe relining work.[[1]](https://omegaservices.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CCYSDyoNCgsvZy8xdGRfNWI1MhgK)

You can check out their service scope or request a booking directly via the Omega Services Official Website.[[1]](https://omegaservices.com.au/)
